hosted-fields.title: Hosted Fields — card tokenization
setup: npm install

Get a .env from the team and put it in the repo root. Hosted fields needs SPREEDLY_ENVIRONMENT_KEY_NEW, CERTIFICATE_TOKEN_NEW, PRIVATE_KEY_NEW, SPREEDLY_ACCESS_SECRET_NEW, SPREEDLY_URL, and SPREEDLY_GATEWAY_TOKEN_NEW for purchase cases. Never commit it.
npm run dev — backend on http://localhost:3000. Or skip the .env and point pages at testData.apiBaseHeroku.
python3 -m http.server 4173 -d qa/hosted-fields/pages — serves the built pages for step 3.

testData.moreTestData: https://developer.spreedly.com/docs/test-data — includes cards that decline, for error cases

upstream: https://core-test.spreedly.com — Spreedly staging: tokenization API and the bundle CDN
